profile_text.body:
Zscaler is a publicly traded cloud security company (Nasdaq: ZS) that describes itself as a leading provider of enterprise security built around a zero trust model. Its flagship platform, the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange, is designed to help organizations securely adopt cloud and digital transformation by connecting users, devices, and applications without relying on traditional network perimeter approaches. The company positions itself as operating what it calls the largest security cloud on the planet, and its partner ecosystem is presented as enabling faster deployments and more agile operations for enterprise customers.

Zscaler's AI product, tracked here as Zscaler AI, encompasses cloud security capabilities including a security service edge platform, data loss prevention, and inspection of AI-generated traffic. The company also highlights a unified zero trust framework intended to govern agent-to-agent interactions and trace data lineage, which it describes as important for compliance and competitive advantage in environments where AI systems communicate with one another.

Zscaler is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001713683 and files as a for-profit public company. No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts at this time.
